scope_note: Four broad query envelopes cover the main island and offshore archipelagos. They include ocean and may include land outside the intended administrative scope. They do not assert sovereignty, a maritime claim, or an exhaustive island inventory. Named windows are display/validation samples, not land masks. No territorial boundary is inferred.
completion_gate: Exhaustive named island inventory and current reusable administrative polygons remain unresolved; queried envelopes and these samples must not be called full provincial land coverage.

quality_notes: All delivered image assets are actual raster-derived pixels. No placeholders or fabricated island values.
Broad geographic envelopes contain ocean and can include land outside the administrative scope; counts are rectangular-grid support, not provincial land completeness.
Native DSM ~30 m, SoilGrids ~250 m and CHIRPS ~5.5 km remain distinct; previews can be coarser.
DSM is historical surface height including vegetation/buildings. Source zero or absent tile does not establish present-day reef or reclaimed-island topography.
CHIRPS data coverage is not temperature, evapotranspiration, or a full climate model.
Offshore soil is audited at four named windows only; no claim of complete offshore soil mapping.

Main-island DSM has continuous 1 arcsecond tiles, with PNG inspection quantized to 1 m and float32 GeoTIFF retained; overview remains at 8 arcseconds. Native tiles carry min_zoom=11 and must be filtered by display LOD.
